annotations.title: Send a deck link to Yann

description: The one-minute pitch: sends the company name, the reply email and a link to the deck (Notion, Google Slides, DocSend, PDF...) that anyone with the link can open. You get back the deal token. Before calling, have the founders accept the privacy notice at https://upto.tech/privacy and set founder_consent to true. One pitch per email per day.

deck_link.description: https link to the deck, open to anyone with the link

founder_consent.description: true only if the founders accepted the privacy notice (https://upto.tech/privacy)

note.description: Optional: one or two lines to add
